objects.description: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used obfuscated PowerShell scripts for staging.(Citation: Microsoft Actinium February 2022)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024) Additionally, (LinkById : G0047) has used PowerShell based tools later in its attack chain.(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_ShuckwormUSB_Apr2025) Additionally, [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used the PowerShell cmdlet `Get-Command` to download and execute the next stage payload.(Citation: VenereCiscoTalos_Gamaredon_Mar2025)
objects.description_fa: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) از اسکریپت های مبهم PowerShell برای مرحله بندی استفاده کرده است. زنجیره.(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_ShuckwormUSB_Apr2025) علاوه بر این، [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) از cmdlet PowerShell «Get-Command» برای دانلود و اجرای بارگذاری مرحله بعدی استفاده کرده است.[[[CTI_PRESERVE_3]] (Citation: Microsoft Actinium February 2022) (Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024) (Citation: VenereCiscoTalos_Gamaredon_Mar2025)
